### God Makes Impossible Things Possible - Truth For Life - January 13
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-january-13-2022.html
Passage: 2 Kings 6:6
Points:
- The lost axe head threatened the prophetic company's honor and seemed hopelessly unrecoverable.
- What is impossible for human strength remains entirely possible for God.
- Faith in the Lord brings unexpected relief in overwhelming callings, severe hardships, and spiritual struggles.
- Believers are urged to bring their heaviest troubles to God, trusting Him to work marvels.

### No Problem Is Too Small for Prayer
Author: Stephen Witmer
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/no-problem-is-too-small-for-prayer
Passage: 2 Kings 6:1-7
Points:
- Scripture highlights that God pays close attention to ordinary, unnamed people and their daily troubles.
- God supplies our needs both through ordinary human initiative and through supernatural intervention.
- Personal losses and inconveniences may seem minor on a grand scale, but they matter to God.
- Believers are invited to pray about every burden, knowing no problem is too small for God's care.
